annotations.title: Chercher un animal à adopter / Search pets for adoption

description: Search cats and dogs for adoption in France, at Mission Museaux and other shelters, near a town, in a department or region, or nationwide, by breed, sex, age and gets-on-with. Returns up to 25 animals with shelter, fee, photo, dates and link; else the closest within 300 km. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

age_max_mois.description: Maximum age in months, inclusive (whole number, 0 to 300), e.g. 11 for under one year or 23 for under two. Animals of unstated age are left out.

age_min_mois.description: Minimum age in months, inclusive (whole number, 0 to 300), e.g. 96 for 8 years or older. Read from the age the shelter wrote; animals of unstated age are left out.

commune.description: French town name or 5-digit postcode (string, 2 to 80 characters), e.g. "Nemours", "77140" or "Chaumont 52" (department number to tell namesakes apart). France only; a place abroad returns no result.

decalage.description: Number of animals to skip, for paging (whole number, 0 to 500, default 0), e.g. 10 for the second page of 10.

departement.description: Department or region instead of a radius (string): code or name, several separated by commas, e.g. "77", "2A", "Bretagne" or "75, 92, 93". A commune given with it only sorts by distance.

ententes.description: Gets on with (list of 1 to 4 values): chats (cats), chiens (dogs), enfants (children), premier_animal (suits a first-time owner), e.g. ["chats", "enfants"]. Only animals whose profile says so are kept.

espece.description: Species: chat (cat) or chien (dog); adoptions only cover cats and dogs. cat, kitten, dog or puppy are accepted. Omit for both.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -90 to 90), e.g. 48.267. Give it with longitude, instead of commune.

limite.description: Number of animals to return (whole number, 1 to 25, default 10); a larger value is lowered to 25. Use decalage for the next page.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -180 to 180), e.g. 2.693. Give it with latitude, instead of commune.

race.description: Breed in French or English (string, 2 to 60 characters), e.g. "labrador", "Maine coon" or "berger australien". A partial name such as "lévrier" covers every breed containing it.

rayon_km.description: Search radius in km around commune or the coordinates (number, 1 to 300, default 60). Without a centre or departement, all of France.

sexe.description: Sex: male or femelle (female). Animals of unstated sex are kept and flagged as not stated.

name: chercher_adoptions

criteres_demandes.description: For each criterion of the request (breed, colour, sex, age, gets-on-with), whether the record states it. Empty when no such criterion was asked.

precise.description: true when the record states this criterion (and matches it); false when it does not say, so it is kept as a possible match.

mise_a_jour_le.description: When the association offering the animal last changed its listing (ISO date); null when unknown, and for Mission Museaux's own animals.

publiee_le.description: When the record was first published (ISO date): on Mission Museaux, at the original platform for a reprise, or by the association offering the animal. null when unknown.

source.description: Where the record comes from: mission_museaux (published on Mission Museaux), reprise (a listing relayed from another platform, not named; contact goes through the original listing) or association_partenaire (an animal offered by another French association or shelter, not registered on Mission Museaux, whose listing Mission Museaux relays).

verifiee_le.description: When Mission Museaux last re-read the listing of the association offering the animal and found it still listed (ISO date); a freshness check, not a verification of the animal. null for Mission Museaux's own animals.

autres.description: The others, to ask for with their department (“Saint-Denis (93)”).

retenue.description: The town used, the most populous (“Saint-Denis (974)”).

homonymes.description: When several towns have exactly the given name and no department tells them apart; null otherwise.

lieu_non_couvert.description: Present when the given town is not a French town: without a requested department, no search took place; Mission Museaux covers France.

raison.description: hors_france: a place abroad (Madrid, London); introuvable: no town of that name.

departement.description: Code of the department where the animal is (“01”).

departement_suffisant.description: For a department search: the departement value that also includes this animal (“Rhône, 01”).

depuis.description: Where the distance is measured from: the search centre, or a prefecture for a department search without a town (“Lyon (préfecture, 69)”).

mise_a_jour_le.description: When the association offering the animal last changed its listing (ISO date); null when unknown, and for Mission Museaux's own animals.

publiee_le.description: When the record was first published (ISO date): on Mission Museaux, at the original platform for a reprise, or by the association offering the animal. null when unknown.

source.description: Where the record comes from: mission_museaux (published on Mission Museaux), reprise (a listing relayed from another platform, not named; contact goes through the original listing) or association_partenaire (an animal offered by another French association or shelter, not registered on Mission Museaux, whose listing Mission Museaux relays).

verifiee_le.description: When Mission Museaux last re-read the listing of the association offering the animal and found it still listed (ISO date); a freshness check, not a verification of the animal. null for Mission Museaux's own animals.

plus_proche.description: In an empty answer, the closest animal meeting the same criteria, up to rayon_max_km from the centre or the prefecture, with its dates and source.

title: Chercher un animal à adopter / Search pets for adoption
